McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

McKesson Commercial Strategy & Innovation Group (CSI) provides technology that supports pharmacy operations and patient care through operational workflow software, clinical programs, and more.

Every single McKesson employee contributes to our mission—by joining McKesson Commercial Strategy and Innovation, you act as a catalyst in a chain of events that helps millions of people all over the globe. We understand the importance of a system that works together.

You’ll collaborate on the products and solutions that help us carry out our mission to improve lives and advance healthcare. Your expertise, drive, and passion can help us improve everything we touch, from providers to payers to pharmacies. Working here is your opportunity to shape an industry that’s vital to us all.

Position Description:

McKesson’s Undergraduate Intern Program provides an opportunity to experience the healthcare industry first-hand and apply academic knowledge in a real-world software engineering environment. Through project-based work across key business initiatives, you will gain hands-on experience developing and testing software solutions, including responsible applications of artificial intelligence and machine learning.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, build a professional network, and strengthen the technical and interpersonal skills needed to succeed in a dynamic and growing business.

Undergraduate Intern Program Details:



- Paid Internship
- Full-time work 
- Position is located in Irving TX, Columbus OH, & Pittsburgh PA
- No company sponsored housing, relocation, visa sponsorship or Green Card assistance available
- The intern will be assigned a project-focused opportunity aligned with a current priority within the McKesson Pharmacy Systems Engineering team. The work may include designing, developing, testing, or evaluating software and AI-enabled capabilities that improve engineering productivity, operational workflows, or user experiences. This is a hands-on opportunity to apply software engineering, data, and responsible AI practices in a dynamic and growing business.
- The internship program also provides networking, access to executives, structured performance, coaching, and fun activities!


Qualifications:

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:



- Must be currently enrolled in a degree program for the duration of the internship to be eligible.
- 3.0 minimum GPA.
- Must be currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s degree program applicable to Software Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field and entering your Junior or Senior year.
- Coding experience in JavaScript, Python, or another programming or scripting language.
- Understanding of relational databases, SQL queries, data structures, and software development fundamentals.


ADDITIONAL KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:



- Willingness to learn, develop, and contribute in an agile development environment.
- Experience with using AI-assisted development tools to improve software quality and engineering efficiency coursework, projects, or hands-on exposure to artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, or natural language processing.
- Energetic and curious self-starter who brings interpersonal skills, sound judgment, and creative problem-solving to the team.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Unity Developer Internship
CANYON ENTERTAINMENT GROUP
Location: Remote / Greater Toronto Area and MississaugaAbout Us
Canyon Entertainment Group represents a roster of high-caliber artists who inspire their fans every day. By constantly learning from our talented array of singers, songwriters, and producers, we strive to create music and live events that spur positive change. Our mission is to empower artists by providing innovative marketing solutions, driving their music to new heights.Position Overview
We are seeking motivated Unity Developer Interns to join our team for a 3 to 6-month internship, working 10 to 20 hours per week. This unpaid position is ideal for College or University students seeking internship credit or hands-on experience in Unity Development, Game Development, Mobile App Development, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Interactive Media, or related fields.
Interns will work closely with our creative and technical teams to develop the core functionality of an interactive mobile application using Unity's 2D workflow while gaining practical experience in software development, mobile application design, testing, and collaboration within a production environment.Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain application features using Unity and C#
- Work with Unity's 2D workflow, including sprites and Canvas UI
- Integrate layered assets such as hairstyles, clothing, backgrounds, and other customizable elements
- Create smooth scene transitions and intuitive user experiences
- Implement sprite swapping for avatar customization
- Develop image capture and social media sharing functionality
- Integrate in-app audio playback features
- Build and maintain a points or rewards system using local storage or Firebase
- Collaborate with designers, artists, and other developers throughout the development process
- Document workflows and development processes where requiredPreferred Additional Skills (Quality Assurance)

- Test mobile applications on iOS and Android devices
- Perform manual testing or utilize the Unity Test Framework
- Identify, document, and assist in resolving bugs
- Verify cross-platform compatibility and application performance
- Ensure social sharing and privacy features meet compliance standards, particularly for younger usersRequirements

- Currently enrolled in College or University in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Game Development, Interactive Media, or a related program
- Experience with Unity and C# programming
- Understanding of Unity's 2D development workflow
- Familiarity with object-oriented programming principles
- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
- Excellent communication and collaboration abilities
- Ability to work independently in a remote environment
- Passion for game and mobile application developmentKey Competencies

- Critical thinking and problem-solving
- Planning and organization
- Attention to detail
- Communication skills
- Team collaboration
- Adaptability and willingness to learn
- Creativity and innovation
- Time managementBenefits

- Gain real-world experience developing a live mobile application
- Strengthen your Unity and C# development skills
- Build a professional portfolio with hands-on project work
- Collaborate with experienced creative and technical professionals
- Flexible remote work environment
- Enhance your resume and career readiness within the software and gaming industriesHow to Apply
If you are passionate about Unity development and eager to gain hands-on experience building real-world mobile applications, we'd love to hear from you. Once your application has been reviewed, our team will contact qualified candidates, and successful applicants may begin immediately.
Job Type: Internship (Unpaid)
Contract Length: 3–6 months
Part-time Hours: 10–20 per weekImportant Details

- This training is similar to that which is provided in a vocational school.
- This training is for your personal benefit to develop your technical skills, portfolio, and resume.
- Your training supervisor will ensure that the activities you work on primarily benefit your learning and professional development.
- This position is solely for educational purposes and does not replace or displace any employees within the company; it is not an offer of employment.
- This is an unpaid internship intended to support students in obtaining university or college internship credit.

Badger Meter - Where Every Drop Counts and So Do You

At Badger Meter, we're more than a leading global water technology company - we're innovators with a mission: to preserve and protect the world's most precious resource. For over 120 years, our trusted solutions have enabled our customers to optimize the delivery and use of water, maximize revenue and reduce waste.

Every employee at Badger Meter is an important part of our success. Here, your work doesn't just move a business forward - it shapes a more sustainable future. We are committed to building a workplace where we celebrate differences, empower voices, and encourage fresh ideas that drive innovation.

When you join us, you'll find:



- Purpose-driven work that makes a real difference in communities around the globe.
- Career growth and development opportunities designed to help you achieve your potential.
- A supportive, inclusive culture where collaboration and creativity thrive. 


Be part of something bigger. At Badger Meter, your contributions will ripple far beyond the workplace - creating lasting change for people and the planet.

What You Will Contribute:

The Badger Meter Internship Program provides hands-on, real-world experience to students through projects that make a difference! In addition to your projects, you will be given the opportunity to participate in our robust Intern program focused on Badger Meter Culture, professional development, community outreach and a final capstone project.
